findings.title: Five environments remain explicit blocked_unavailable without invented pins
findings.evidence: solana.json, cosmos.json, move-sui.json, sovereign-cross-chain.json, and payment-channel.json set verified_source_pin, verified_deployment, and verified_toolchain to null. Status is blocked_unavailable. readiness_accepted and p34_execution_accepted are false. Unblock requirements name a P32 source pin, a chain-specific compiler/runtime, local execution/deployment binding, and later P33/P34 preservation.
findings.fix: Do not relabel these as available platforms. To unblock one environment: select and pin an implementation commit through the P32 source gate; locate and verify the chain-specific toolchain and version; bind local execution/deployment configuration; then independently re-review that record.

findings.title: Readiness records do not accept P34, whole-program completion, or other-environment scores
findings.evidence: Every record sets p34_execution_accepted false and new_execution_cases 0. readiness-index.json sets full_p32_accepted false, full_p34_accepted false, whole_program_complete false. evm.json remaining text states prior token0 evidence scores only its scoped EVM function. Spec scenario: EVM pin counts as EVM evidence for the declared function, not as coverage of other environments. Line 1116 is an excerpt, not a toolchain existence proof. No mainnet identity is claimed.
findings.fix: Keep P34 open. After P33, run nonempty success and refusal per required environment or keep those environments blocked. Do not inherit EVM scores.

findings.title: Probe helper stored in-process step labels that were not separate argv
findings.evidence: commands-raw.json lists --bounded-discovery and --evm-crosscheck on run_probes.py. Those flags were not parsed and were not separate processes. The only nested subprocesses inside run_probes.py were the two absolute-path --version commands. Final commands.json records in-process steps with argv null.
findings.fix: Treat commands.json as the command ledger. Preserve commands-raw.json as a failed/misleading source of argv, not as proof of extra processes.
